tasks.title: Bundle set up
tasks.hint: Run: node mw.js init  (name, email, WhatsApp number, path to one of your own git repos).

tasks.title: Claude Code answers
tasks.hint: Install with: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code, then run claude once and log in with your Claude account.

tasks.title: CLAUDE.md in your own repo
tasks.hint: In YOUR repo (the one you gave mw init): run claude, type /init, then edit CLAUDE.md: how to run, how to test, what Claude must not touch. At least 20 non-empty lines with a # heading.

tasks.title: Personal rules
tasks.hint: Create ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md with at least 5 lines of rules that apply to every project (reply style, commit style, what to always ask first).

tasks.title: Plan before code
tasks.hint: In plan mode (Shift+Tab twice) ask Claude to plan one small change in your repo. Save the plan it shows as .maxwizer/evidence/plan-day1.md in the bundle (10+ lines). Do not build it yet.

tasks.title: Starter tests green
tasks.hint: cd starter, npm install, npm test. One test fails on purpose: GET /health must also return version 1.0.0. Ask Claude to explore, fix the one line, and run npm test again.

tasks.title: CSV export built
tasks.hint: Inside starter: git init if not yet, commit main, then git checkout -b feature/csv-export. Give Claude starter/FEATURE.md as the brief, plan first, build GET /expenses/export.csv with test/export.test.js, npm test green, commit.

tasks.title: On your own GitHub
tasks.hint: Create an empty repo under YOUR GitHub account, then inside starter: git remote add origin <your url> and git push -u origin feature/csv-export. The remote must be yours, not maxwize.
